author: Tooth
body: Alright so as many of you know (well let's be honest I'm just a randy) I upload Avicus Montages on my channel and I also post them here on the forums. In those videos I play on the account 'Tooth'. I just recently sold the account and now I need to know what I'm supposed to do to change my profile on here as it is still linked to the account. I don't want to go through the trouble of making a new forums account because this is where I've posted all my videos and where I plan on continuing to post. I'm not asking anyone in particular but if you've got some suggestions or feedback feel free to respond to this thread.
